name: Waldorf Astoria Jeddah Qasr Al Sharq
insider_take: A true Palace of the East — where Arabian grandeur meets Red Sea serenity on Jeddah's legendary Corniche.
whats_special: Waldorf Astoria Jeddah – Qasr Al Sharq is a breathtaking landmark whose name literally translates to "Palace of the East." Draped in stunning Islamic architecture and positioned directly on the Corniche waterfront, this hotel is a living tribute to Arabian heritage. Guests enjoy sweeping Red Sea views, opulent interiors adorned with hand-crafted details, and world-class service — all hallmarks of the legendary Waldorf Astoria brand.
pro_tip: Request a room or suite facing the Red Sea and time your arrival at sunset — the sky over the water turns an extraordinary palette of gold and amber, rivaling any view in the world.
dont_miss: Step outside and witness the King Fahd Fountain , one of the world's tallest fountains, dramatically illuminated at night just moments from the hotel. Explore Jeddah's UNESCO-listed Al-Balad Historic District , a maze of centuries-old coral-stone buildings and traditional souks, for an authentic dive into Saudi Arabia's rich cultural soul.
pros: Iconic Corniche Waterfront Location — Situated directly on Jeddah's celebrated Red Sea Corniche, offering sweeping sea views and easy access to the city's most scenic promenade.
Palatial Arabian Architecture & Interiors — The hotel's stunning palace-inspired design, ornate detailing, and luxurious decor deliver an authentic sense of Saudi Arabian grandeur.
World-Class Dining Experiences — Multiple acclaimed restaurants and lounges offer a curated blend of international and regional cuisine, including elevated fine dining with Red Sea vistas.
Exceptional Spa & Wellness Facilities — The dedicated spa and wellness center provides a serene retreat with signature treatments, separate facilities for men and women, and a tranquil atmosphere.
Impeccable Personalized Service — True Waldorf Astoria hallmark service with dedicated butlers, attentive staff, and meticulous attention to every guest detail.
cons: Ultra-Luxury Price Point — As one of Jeddah's most prestigious addresses, room rates reflect the exclusive positioning, which may not suit all budget ranges.
Alcohol-Free Environment — In keeping with Saudi Arabian regulations and cultural norms, no alcoholic beverages are served on property.
Urban City-Center Setting — While centrally located, guests seeking a remote beach resort escape may find the urban Corniche environment less secluded.
